method: Every row below is an external fact quoted in submission/*.md. Each source is one that BIG_PICTURE.md (revision 2) lists, and each link was re-opened by the ship-deck step on 2026-11-14 between 22:53 and 23:03 UTC. For the two PDFs, the copy read tonight is identified by its SHA-256. 'values' are the numbers as the source states them; submission/check_numbers.py formats the documents' strings from these values. Short source fragments are kept only where needed to show the wording; everything else is paraphrased. Facts already in data/evidence/literature-v1.json are cited from there, not repeated here.

rows.claim: Five-year cancer survival in Finland is significantly lower among people with lower education (men 64%, women 65%) than with higher education (men 77%, women 78%); estimates do not significantly differ across regions.
rows.fragment: Estimates do not significantly differ across regions
rows.citation: OECD/European Commission. EU Country Cancer Profile: Finland 2025.

rows.claim: Breast screening participation 2020-21: 63% among non-domestic-language speakers against 82% among Finnish, Swedish and Sami speakers; 66% with lower against 85% with higher education. Lowest programme participation in Uusimaa, particularly Helsinki, likely because opportunistic screening outside the programme is more frequent there.
rows.citation: OECD/European Commission. EU Country Cancer Profile: Finland 2025.

rows.claim: The OECD/EU profile reports Finnish maximum waiting-time targets for specialised treatment, such as six weeks between a referral concerning a suspected cancer and the start of primary treatment.
rows.fragment: such as six weeks between a referral concerning a suspected case of cancer
rows.note: The legal status is not confirmed: the STM treatment-guarantee page (row stm-hoitotakuu) names no cancer-specific limit. SAMA labels every 42-day threshold 'placeholder (OECD/EU-reported target)'.
rows.citation: OECD/European Commission. EU Country Cancer Profile: Finland 2025.

rows.claim: Specialised care: assessment of need starts within three weeks of the referral arriving, tests and specialist assessment within three months, treatment no later than six months after the need is established. The page names no cancer-specific limit. Non-urgent primary-care maximum times lengthened from the start of 2025.
Stage was available for 42% of cancers nationally; Pirkanmaa 72%, Sisä-Suomi 60%, other areas 33-42%; the aim is at least 70%.

Law changes in force from 1 June 2026 let wellbeing services counties identify patients whose care does not follow recommendations; handling patient data and contacting patients must respect data protection and self-determination.
rows.fragment: voidaan tunnistaa potilaita, joiden hoito ei vastaa suosituksia
rows.note: Whether 'recommendations' covers the timing of pathway steps is UNVERIFIED; confirm with STM and THL.

rows.claim: In a randomised trial of AI prioritisation of GP chest X-rays (93,326 X-rays analysed), the median time to CT was 53 days in both arms; ratio of geometric means 0.97 (95% CI 0.93-1.02; P = 0.31).

Finnish DLBCL cohort: median symptom-to-treatment interval 127 days (mean 201) when the first contact was a public primary-care appointment (48 patients) against 76 days (mean 126) through private or occupational care (39 patients); Mann-Whitney p = 0.027.
rows.note: Corrects the earlier deck: '207 vs 123 days on average, 160 patients' was read from Figure 1, and the first author is Joonas Kuitunen (Kuitunen J), not 'Kuitunen H'. The medians also appear in data/evidence/literature-v1.json (kuitunen-2026-route-medians).
rows.citation: Kuitunen J, et al. Cancer Medicine 2026;15(5):e71920. doi:10.1002/cam4.71920.

rows.claim: The NHS-Galleri randomised trial of a multi-cancer early detection blood test did not meet its primary endpoint (stage III-IV reduction); the stage IV incidence rate ratio after three rounds was 0.86 (0.744-0.998), described as nominally significant; no mortality results were reported.
rows.citation: GRAIL press release, 30 May 2026 (2026 ASCO Annual Meeting), via BioSpace.

rows.claim: When Helsinki removed pre-booked appointment times from cervical screening invitations, participation fell from 72% to about 62%; after the city returned to the old practice it rose to its original level.
rows.note: One city, before-after, no years given in the article. The effect in another county is a SCENARIO.

rows.claim: THL's specialised-care access statistic covers non-urgent care only, as month-end snapshots; counties move to person-level delivery through the TTP data collection. The page gives 1.1.2026 in one section and 1.1.2028 in another.
rows.citation: THL quality report, Hoitoonpääsy erikoissairaanhoidossa, updated 17 Aug 2026.

rows.claim: The Cancer Organisations say no funding is in sight for implementing the national cancer strategy next year (2027), a 'gap year'.
EU AI Act high-risk rules apply from 2 December 2027 for Annex III systems and from 2 August 2028 for AI in regulated products, after the AI Omnibus entered into force on 27 July 2026.
rows.citation: European Commission, Regulatory framework for AI, updated 19 October 2026.

rows.claim: There are 21 wellbeing services counties; the City of Helsinki organises its own health, social and rescue services. SAMA's 23 areas are these 22 plus Åland.
rows.citation: STM, Wellbeing services counties (no date on page).

rows.claim: Lung cancers found in time are mostly found by chance, on lung imaging taken for another reason (printed p. 19). Five-year lung cancer survival: men with basic education about 13% against about 18% with tertiary education; women about 20% against about 30% (printed p. 12, 2020-22).
rows.note: Within-sex contrasts only; do not compare 30% with 13%.
rows.citation: Filha. Valtakunnallinen keuhkosyöpäohjelma 2026-2035, preprint (PDF created 21 May 2026).
